source_message.speaker: client
source_message.text: The work looks great so far, and Option 2 is closer to the direction we want. Since we have 4 bundles, could the pricing section contain 4 boxes? On the home screen, please reduce the amount of blue so the image receives more emphasis, while still retaining a little blue. Could you also give the homepage gallery some basic animation? Finally, please add a button or section in the pricing area that leads visitors to more detailed pricing information. Thank you!

routing_warnings.description: The requested hover animations apply to Gallery-page items rather than the homepage gallery animation.
The request to disable mobile hover animations concerns Gallery-page hover effects, not the homepage gallery animation.
The Elementor limitation concerns device-specific hover effects and belongs to the Gallery Hover Effects Requirement.
The decision to retain the animations resolves the mobile hover-effects discussion rather than changing the homepage gallery animation.
